author_doubts_decisions.decision: Accept the familiar gesture and stated classroom game. Replace the phone distractor with the nearby classroom board, so the gesture cannot favour an answer candidate. Both keys remain the writing instruction.

Accept the literal arrangement. Socks can remain in a box intended for a cat, and neither question asks why. Replace triangular ears with unmistakably human paper ears so no animal option gains a visual cue.
Repair the offer to name broden and the reply to Twee broden, graag. The tested count is now complete in a single turn. No visual loaves or counting gestures.

Repair. Keep intended mail reading for Ruth and replace the mirrored Roos question with Ruth’s phone state. Both correct facts occur together in her own turn, and source/explanations/options are rebuilt.
Keep bakery order-plus-quantity and café meal-plus-drink as distinct beginner purposes. Replace party food preparation with setting out chairs; no third food-order task remains.
Record all five requested editorial ratings per item, with brief-stage labels for visual judgments. Generated media must receive separate review.
Remove the bag/paper mappings and omit the entire table from the image. The single pen location is explicit in Ruben’s short reply; no visual position can identify a key or favour an alternative.
Make the flower visibly folded paper, with no liquid or soil, to remove watering cues. The surprising mug remains context rather than a drink clue.
